ValidationRule.description: This validation rule has been created as part of user story to throw error when an Account on Quote is changed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRByPassToggle__c )), ISCHANGED( SBQQ__Account__c ), ISBLANK(PMC_CPQ_LegacyQuoteID__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change account value on quote
